title: maintenant
name: maintenant
description: Self-hosted monitoring for Docker: container discovery, endpoint and TLS checks, cron heartbeats, logs, image updates, alerts and a status page, in a single Go binary. Source: https://github.com/kOlapsis/maintenant

env.name: MAINTENANT_BASE_URL
env.label: Address you'll open maintenant at
env.description: The address in your browser, for example http://nas.lan:8080. The dashboard answers to IP addresses and to this host name only. The links in alert notifications are built from it too.

env.name: MAINTENANT_DISABLE_TELEMETRY
env.label: Anonymous usage telemetry
env.description: One anonymous snapshot at startup, then every hour, to metrics.kolapsis.com. See the note below.

note: Open http://<server-ip>:8080, or the port you chose. To open it by a host name, enter that address in the first field, otherwise the dashboard answers 421. For several host names, add MAINTENANT_ALLOWED_HOSTS to the stack's environment variables with all of them, comma-separated, the one of the first field included. maintenant has no login of its own, so keep the port on a trusted network or put a reverse proxy with authentication in front of it. The Docker socket is only mounted into a filtering proxy that allows read-only API calls: maintenant can read the details and logs of your containers but cannot change them. /proc and /etc/os-release are bind-mounted read-only for host metrics: if your Portainer restricts bind mounts, deploy it as an admin. Data lives in the maintenant-data volume. Telemetry: maintenant sends an anonymous usage snapshot to metrics.kolapsis.com at startup and then every hour: a random installation ID, the version, edition and storage engine, counts of monitored objects and runtime figures (OS, architecture, CPU cores, memory). It never sends host names, IP addresses, container names or URLs. Set the telemetry field to Disabled to turn it off (exact payload). To check for image updates, it also contacts the registries of your images and endoflife.date. Docs: docs.maintenant.dev
